title: ML↔DATA-001: Training Dataset + Feature Pipeline Handoff
description: Data Engineer delivers curated, versioned datasets and engineered features (incl. the quantization-calibration set) to Edge AI/ML against stated dataset/feature requirements with leakage-safe split definitions. Grounded in DATA_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.2 and EDGE_AI_ML_ENGINEER §6 (DATA boundary).

storage_location.description: S3/GCS URI or local path prefix to the dataset.

feature_spec.description: Engineered feature definitions delivered to ML.

unit.description: Physical unit (required for NUMERIC features per measure-first discipline).

split_definitions.description: Train/validation/test split definitions designed to avoid leakage.

split_key.description: Grouping key ensuring no record group spans splits (leakage prevention), e.g. device_id or field_site.

calibration_set_included.description: True when a representative dataset for INT8 quantization calibration is provided.

lineage_ref.description: Data lineage / provenance reference for the dataset version.

open_dqirs.description: Open Data Quality Issue Report IDs on this dataset version; CRITICAL/HIGH block the training pipeline (see ML↔DATA-DQIR-002).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine dataset delivery and schema interpretation within rubric (agent-autonomous if confidence ≥ 0.70). Breaking feature/schema changes escalate to ADR (Tier-2).
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (requirements handoff at planning; dataset delivery/iteration during development); CONTINUOUS (data-quality reviews)
confirm_conditions: dataset_version resolves in the data catalog and storage_location is reachable
split_definitions sum to 1.0 (±0.001) and split_key enforces leakage-safe grouping
every NUMERIC feature carries a unit
open_dqirs contains no CRITICAL/HIGH DQIR (training pipeline not blocked)
calibration set present when INT8 quantization is planned
reject_conditions: split fractions do not sum to 1.0 or no split_key (leakage risk)
an open CRITICAL or HIGH DQIR is associated with this dataset version
storage_location unreachable or version absent from the catalog
counter_conditions: feature added/renamed vs. the agreed feature spec — request a feature-spec version bump
calibration_set_included = false but quantization is INT8 — request the calibration set before handoff
